{
  "root_cause": "The Escape key handler in the list navigation clears the input value, causing the typed city to be lost when dismissing suggestions.",
  "repair_strategy": "Remove the line that clears the input value and the associated clear event emission in the Escape case of the navigate handler, so that Escape only closes the suggestion list while preserving the user's input.",
  "edits": [
    {
      "path": "src/controllers/listController.js",
      "sha256": "913fcec2ffc448fd458cae19dd873623256f7e1c1ba3eab15225d68f74351f8f",
      "before": "    // Esc\n    case 27:\n      // Clear \"input\" value\n      ctx.input.value = \"\";\n\n      /**\n       * @emit {clear} event on input clear\n       **/\n      eventEmitter(\"clear\", ctx);\n\n      close(ctx);\n      break;",
      "after": "    // Esc\n    case 27:\n      close(ctx);\n      break;"
    }
  ],
  "expected_accessibility_effect": "Escape will close the suggestion list without altering the input value, preserving keyboard operability and ensuring the user's entered text remains available for submission or further editing.",
  "functional_risks": [
    "Any code that relies on the 'clear' event emitted when Escape is pressed may no longer receive that event.",
    "If other parts of the application expect the input to be emptied on Escape, they would need to adapt."
  ],
  "verification_requirements": [
    "Verify that pressing Escape closes the suggestion list (aria-expanded becomes false, list hidden).",
    "Verify that the input value remains unchanged after Escape.",
    "Verify that focus remains on the input field after Escape.",
    - Verify that form data reflects the typed value after Escape.",
    "Ensure that arrow key navigation, Enter selection, and Tab selection (if enabled) continue to work as expected."
  ]
}
